name: Hot Roomies: A Love Triangle
source:
You just graduated from college and are prepared for your first taste of independence and maturity, then everything changes when an old friend of past and a long-time idol whirled into your life. Suddenly, you are about to start a life with two attractive roommates?!

You realize there is more in life than just keeping your nose to the grindstone, and perhaps those silly crushes you have always been immune to, aren't that silly at all. Could this be true love or just another fairy tale?

Only time will tell.

[From Google Play]
translation:
你刚刚从大学毕业，准备第一次尝到独立和成熟的滋味，然后当一位过去的老朋友和一位长期的偶像闯入你的生活时，一切都改变了。突然之间，你就要开始和两个漂亮的室友一起生活了？！

你意识到生活中不仅仅是埋头苦干，也许你一直对那些愚蠢的迷恋免疫，其实一点也不傻。这是真爱还是只是另一个童话故事？

只有时间才能证明一切。

[来自谷歌播放]
